scope: Upper-limb nerve pilot enabled by default on codex/newdatabase

registration.method: Mean center-offset translation using the right clavicle, scapula, and humerus as BodyParts3D anchors

adaptations.structure: axillary nerve and superior lateral cutaneous nerve of arm
adaptations.method: Feathered radial contraction toward the BodyParts3D humeral axis, limited to the lateral shoulder segment
adaptations.reason: Keep the post-quadrangular-space course close to the surgical neck and deep surface of the deltoid while preserving the medial origin

adaptations.method: Feathered anterior path offsets immediately distal to the cubital tunnel
adaptations.reason: Move the proximal forearm segment between the flexor carpi ulnaris heads and onto the anterior surface of flexor digitorum profundus while preserving the retro-epicondylar segment
